SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id AS resource_id, 'CONTAINER' AS object_type, c.container_no AS object_label, 'CONTAINER' AS wait_type, NULL AS vehicle_source, ( SELECT yt.id FROM yms_yard_task yt WHERE yt.container_no = c.container_no AND yt.deleted = 0 AND yt.warehouse_id = c.warehouse_id AND yt.yard_status NOT IN ('LEFT_YARD', 'CANCELLED', 'EXCEPTION_CLOSED') ORDER BY yt.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS related_task_id, ( SELECT yt.yard_task_no FROM yms_yard_task yt WHERE yt.container_no = c.container_no AND yt.deleted = 0 AND yt.warehouse_id = c.warehouse_id AND yt.yard_status NOT IN ('LEFT_YARD', 'CANCELLED', 'EXCEPTION_CLOSED') ORDER BY yt.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS related_task_no, c.arrived_time AS arrived_time, CASE WHEN c.arrived_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.arrived_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END AS wait_minutes, c.container_status AS status, CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN COALESCE(c.exception_reason, '资源异常') WHEN c.container_status = 'CALLED' THEN '已叫号，等待进场Dock' WHEN c.dock_id IS NULL THEN '等待Dock分配' ELSE '排队等待叫号' END AS block_reason, c.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN 0 WHEN c.container_status IN ('WAIT_DEVANNING', 'YARD_ASSIGNED', 'DROPPED', 'ARRIVED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS callable FROM yms_container_resource c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.container_status IN ('ARRIVED', 'YARD_ASSIGNED', 'DROPPED', 'WAIT_DEVANNING', 'CALLED')
UNION ALL
SELECT t.id AS resource_id, 'TRAILER' AS object_type, COALESCE(t.trailer_no, t.plate_no) AS object_label, CASE WHEN t.vehicle_source = 'RENTED_TRAILER' THEN 'RENTED_TRAILER' ELSE 'LOADING' END AS wait_type, t.vehicle_source AS vehicle_source, t.related_loading_task_id AS related_task_id, yt.yard_task_no AS related_task_no, t.arrive_time AS arrived_time, CASE WHEN t.arrive_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.arrive_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END AS wait_minutes, t.trailer_status AS status, CASE WHEN t.exception_flag = 1 THEN COALESCE(t.exception_reason, '资源异常') WHEN t.wms_ready_status IS NOT NULL AND t.wms_ready_status != 'READY' THEN '货未备齐' WHEN t.trailer_status = 'CALLED' THEN '已叫号，等待进场Dock' WHEN t.dock_id IS NULL THEN '等待Dock分配' ELSE '排队等待叫号' END AS block_reason, t.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, CASE WHEN t.exception_flag = 1 THEN 0 WHEN t.trailer_status IN ('WAIT_LOADING', 'ARRIVED_EMPTY') AND (t.wms_ready_status IS NULL OR t.wms_ready_status = 'READY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS callable FROM yms_trailer_resource t LEFT JOIN yms_yard_task yt ON yt.id = t.related_loading_task_id AND yt.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.trailer_status IN ('ARRIVED_EMPTY', 'WAIT_LOADING', 'CALLED') ) pool WHERE 1 = 1
AND pool.warehouse_id = #{bo.warehouseId}
AND pool.wait_type = #{bo.waitType}
AND pool.object_label LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY pool.arrived_time ASC
